timeZone.description: Where the schedule's times are: an IANA time zone such as "Europe/Istanbul", or "person" to run once for each person at that time in their own time zone (ctx.payload is a PersonCronPayload). Default: the host's time zone.

device.description: Runs the handler on a device event: notifications/action (an action tapped on a notification this hob sent), focus/changed (a Focus mode with a Hobwork Focus filter turned on or off), nfc/scanned (a tag this hob wrote was scanned, or with url any scanned URL starting with it), health/samples (new Health samples), alarms/fired, alarms/stopped and alarms/repeated (an alarm or timer this hob set rang, was stopped, or its repeat button started a new countdown). ctx.payload is the matching DeviceEvent from @hobwork/sdk.
Only events from the device with this name, as ctx.device() takes it.

url.description: nfc/scanned only: runs the handler for scanned URLs that start with this, such as "https://example.com/spools/", from tags Hobwork did not write too. Tags reach Hobwork through the app's Scan Tag button or the "Send Tag to Hobwork" Shortcuts action. Without it, only tags this hob wrote.

upload.description: Runs the handler when a file arrives through the upload with this name in "uploads". ctx.payload is an UploadEvent from @hobwork/sdk (upload, path, size, modified, contentType), and ctx.caller the person who uploaded it from the app, or null for an upload token.

uploads.description: Where the hob's app (files.upload from @hobwork/sdk/browser) and scripts with an upload token may store files in the hob's files (ctx.files) directly, without a handler and past the 10 MB limit of route bodies. The key names the upload, for triggers and upload tokens. Signed-in people can upload from the app; scripts need the upload's token, which people create on the hob's page and agents with rotate_upload_token.

prefix.description: Directory of the hob's files that uploads go to, ending in "/", like "inbox/" or "photos/raw/". Uploaded paths must start with it.

maxBytes.description: Largest file, in bytes. Default 104857600 (100 MB), at most 1073741824 (1 GB).

types.description: Files to accept, by MIME type ("image/*", "application/pdf") or extension (".3mf"). A file passes when its Content-Type or its name matches one. Default: any file.

egress.description: Hosts handlers may reach over HTTP and HTTPS. "api.example.com" or "*.example.com" on any port, "host:port" ("[IPv6]:port") on that port only. Private, LAN and tailnet addresses (like "100.66.127.125:7912") work only when the Hobwork host lists them too, in HOBWORK_PRIVATE_EGRESS. Secrets are only sent over https.

csp.description: Extra sources for the Content-Security-Policy of the hob's app. By default the app runs only scripts from its own origin (no inline scripts) and loads styles, images, fonts and connections from its own origin (also inline styles, and data: and blob: images, data: fonts). Each directive lists what to allow in addition: http(s):// or ws(s):// origins ("https://cdn.example.com", "https://*.example.com", "wss://live.example.com"), data: or blob: where the directive takes them, and in script-src the keywords "'unsafe-inline'", "'unsafe-eval'" and "'wasm-unsafe-eval'", which remove the protection against injected scripts. frame-ancestors cannot be changed.

crossAppRequests.description: Names of the hobs whose apps may send requests to this hob's app (its UI and routes). Every other hob's app is refused, on every method including GET. Webhooks are called with their own token and are not affected. Empty by default.

static.description: Serves directories of the hob's files (ctx.files) at paths of its app, straight from the host without starting the hob's VM. The key is the URL path, the value names the directory: "/photos": { "dir": "photos" } serves the file photos/2026/cat.jpg at /photos/2026/cat.jpg. Only to signed-in users and share links, like the UI, unless "public" is true. A path here wins over the UI's files. It cannot be under /api, /_hobwork or /theme. Images, audio, video, PDF, fonts and plain text are shown in the browser; every other file is a download.

dir.description: Directory of the hob's files, like "photos" or "uploads/avatars".

public.description: Serve the files to anyone with the link, without signing in. Default false.

resources.description: Memory and vCPUs for the hob's VMs, for a hob that needs less than the defaults so the host has room for more VMs. The runtime (which also runs branch previews) defaults to 256 MB and 0.5 vCPUs, workspaces and pipeline runs (which also run builds) to 1536 MB and 2 vCPUs. Values above the defaults are capped to them. A `cpus` below one is a share of a core: the VM boots with one vCPU and the host caps its CPU time at that share, with cgroup v2. A host without cgroup v2 refuses a fraction, and its runtime default is one vCPU.

icon.description: The hob's icon, shown as its app's favicon and home screen icon and in hob lists: one emoji ("🧵") or the path of an SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP image in the repo ("ui/icon.svg"). Hobwork renders it to every size it needs. Without it, the icon is the hob's first letter.

widget.description: A Home Screen and Lock Screen widget for the hob in the Hobwork app. Hobwork calls the GET route at this path with ctx.caller set to the person whose device shows it, and the route returns WidgetContent from @hobwork/sdk (title, lines, swatches, open). ctx.person(id).widgets.reload() refreshes it.

intents.description: Actions of the hob in Shortcuts, Siri, the Action Button and Control Center ("Run Hob Action" in the Hobwork app). An intent with a route runs it (default POST, body IntentRequest from @hobwork/sdk, ctx.caller set to the person and device) and the route may return IntentResult: say is what Siri says. An intent with open and no route opens the app at that path of the hob's UI.

parameters.description: What Shortcuts and Siri ask for before running the route, handed over in IntentRequest.parameters by id.

opensApp.description: Opens the app after the route ran: at the path the route returns as open, else at open, else at the hob's home.

open.description: A path of the hob's UI, e.g. "/scan".

share.description: Targets of the hob in the share sheet ("Share to Hobwork" in the Hobwork app on iPhone and iPad). The person picks a target for a link, text or files they share from another app. Files are uploaded into the upload named by upload first; then Hobwork runs the POST route with body ShareRequest from @hobwork/sdk ({ target, url?, text?, files }) and ctx.caller set to the person and device. The route may return ShareResult: say is shown in the share sheet.

title.description: What the share sheet lists, e.g. "Add to the queue".

accepts.description: What the target takes. It is offered when the shared items include something it accepts.

files.description: Files by MIME type ("model/3mf", "image/*") or extension (".3mf"), as in uploads. Needs upload.

upload.description: The upload (a key of uploads) that shared files go into.

route.description: The POST route that receives the ShareRequest.

appLinks.description: Which links to the hob's app open in the Hobwork app (universal links) when it is installed, instead of in the browser. Default: every page of the UI. Paths under /api, /_hobwork, /theme and the static directories never do. Patterns are URL paths where * matches any characters and ? one character, as in an apple-app-site-association file.

include.description: Only these paths open the app, e.g. ["/spool/*", "/bin/*"].

exclude.description: These paths stay in the browser, e.g. ["/print/*"]. They win over include.
